metadata.dcterms:title: 2-VECTOR SPACES AND GROUPOIDS
metadata.dcterms:creator: MORTON, JEFFREY C.
metadata.dcterms:abstract: This paper describes a relationship between essentially ﬁnite groupoids and 2-vector spaces. In particular, we show to construct 2-vector spaces of Vect-valued presheaves on such groupoids. We deﬁne 2-linear maps corre- sponding to functors between groupoids in both a covariant and contravariant way, which are ambidextrous adjoints. This is used to construct a representation— a weak functor—from Span(FinGpd) (the bicategory of essentially ﬁnite groupoids and spans of groupoids) into 2Vect. In this paper we prove this and give the construction in detail.
